How to Use the Course Grade Calculator

Enter each of your assignments, exams, or grade categories along with their weight (how much they count toward your final grade) and the score you received. Weights should add up to 100%, but if you haven't entered everything yet, the calculator automatically assumes the rest of your class makes up the difference.

Hit Calculate Grade to see your current standing. If you have ungraded work remaining, you'll also see your current performance on graded work only so you always know exactly where you stand. Use What Do I Need to Pass? to find out the average score you need on remaining assignments to hit your target grade.

Save your classes with the 💾 Saved Classes button so you can come back any time without re-entering everything. You can organize classes into folders by semester or subject, and load them in one click whenever grades come in.

📋 Copy Grade Summary

Your grade summary will be copied to your clipboard. Want to include what average you need on remaining assignments to pass?

How to Use the Grade Calculator

A weighted course grade calculator. Enter your assignments, their weight (how much they count toward your final grade), and the grade you received. Leave a grade blank if it hasn't been scored yet. Your classes and preferences are automatically saved and will be there when you return.

Calculating Your Grade

Fill in your assignments and click Calculate Grade. If you have ungraded assignments, you'll see two results: Current Course Performance (graded work only) and Overall Grade (blanks counted as 0), along with a full breakdown table showing each assignment's weight, grade, and points contributed.

Click What Do I Need to Pass? (or Did I Pass My Class? once all grades are entered) to open a popup. Enter your passing threshold (e.g. 70%) and hit Enter or the button. It tells you the average needed on remaining work, or whether you've already passed or fallen short.

The What do I need to get a __% ? box at the bottom updates live as you type. Enter any target grade to instantly see what average you'd need on remaining assignments.

After calculating, click 📋 Copy Grade Summary to copy a formatted summary of your grades to your clipboard, ready to paste anywhere.

Keyboard Navigation

Tab or →
Move right to the next field. Wraps to the first field of the next row.
←
Move left to the previous field. Wraps to the last field of the row above.
↑ / ↓
Move up or down one row, staying in the same column.
Enter
Move down one row. At the bottom, wraps to the top of the next column. If all weights and grades are filled, triggers Calculate Grade automatically.
Backspace
On an empty field, moves up to the previous row instead of deleting.
Esc
On an empty row, deletes that row and moves focus to the nearest row.
Ctrl + Z
Undo the last change. Also available as the ↩ Undo button in the toolbar.

Other Controls

+
Add Assignment: appends a new blank row to the table.
✕
Delete row: removes that assignment row. On mobile, swipe a row left to delete it.
↺ Reset
Clears all rows and results, starting fresh with blank rows.
🌙
Toggle between light and dark mode. Your preference is remembered when you return.
● Color
Pick a custom accent color. Hit ↺ beside it to reset to the default blue. Your preference is remembered when you return.
📋 Copy Grade Summary
Appears below the breakdown after calculating. Copies a formatted grade summary to your clipboard. Optionally includes what average you need on remaining work to pass.
Did I Pass?
The "What Do I Need to Pass?" button automatically changes to "Did I Pass My Class?" once every assignment has a grade entered.

Saving Classes

Click 💾 Saved Classes in the toolbar to open the class manager. Type a name for your current setup (e.g. "Biology 101") and hit Save. It stores all your assignments, weights, and grades. Optionally assign it to a folder before saving.

Load
Replaces the current table with that class's saved data. A banner appears at the top showing which class you're editing.
Save Changes
While a class is loaded, use this banner button to overwrite it with your latest edits.
✎
Rename a saved class inline.
⤴
Move a class into a folder, or back to the top level.
Unlink
Disconnects the current table from a saved class without deleting the save.

Search & Folders

Use the search bar at the top of the class manager to instantly filter your saved classes by name. Results update as you type. Press ✕ to clear.

📁 New Folder
Creates a named folder to group related classes (e.g. "Fall Semester"). Folders can be nested inside other folders.
📂 / 📁
Click a folder header to expand or collapse it.
⤴
Move a folder inside another folder, or back to the top level.
✎
Rename a folder inline.
✕
Delete a folder. Classes inside are moved back to the top level, not deleted.
